first_public_date_evidence: Earliest precisely day-dated supporting preprint: arXiv:1206.6004 first version 2012-06-26. Riera–Rodríguez earlier primary publication is identified only by month May 1992; no day is imputed to it.
scientific_integrity: Published period/homology and theta-orbit data are credited as prior facts. The new claim is the explicit binary even-subset model and commuting orthogonal group action that bundles individual theta orbits. A finite quadratic symmetry need not lift to the Jacobian or the curve.
scientific_limitations: No claim to a curve/Jacobian automorphism corresponding to the commuting binary S3.
The known numerical 120 and 136 orbit counts are not themselves a novel output.
The underlying integral symplectic commutant was already investigated in 1992; novelty applies to the induced characteristic-orbit grouping and explicit even-subset model.
Historical priority has bounded literature-search uncertainty; there is no independent audit.
title: A commuting \(S_3\) explains the theta-orbit triples on Bring's curve
